<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me try clicking the blue target to scatter the dots again

result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 37, 'col': 48}])
print(f"Click blue target: board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
b_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
print(f"\nBlue objects after click:")
for n in b_nodes:
    r1, c1 = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
    r2, c2 = max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
    print(f"  [{r1},{c1}]-[{r2},{c2}], px={n['pixels']}")

# Now move N up to be adjacent to scattered dots
# N is at [42,12], need to move UP twice to [38,12]
if not result.get('level_completed'):
    result2 = action(['UP', 'UP'])
    print(f"\nMove N up twice: board_changed={result2.get('board_changed')}")
    print(f"Level completed: {result2.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
